-97.85410,30.31330.name: Austin Fertility and Reproductive Medicine-Westlake IVF
-97.85410,30.31330.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Shahryar K. Kavoussi, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-87.62442,41.87556.name: Jesse Brown Veterans Affairs Medical Center
-87.62442,41.87556.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Department of Veterans Affairs. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-64.78699,46.10559.name: Université de Moncton
-64.78699,46.10559.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, January 2025
-64.78699,46.10559.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, January 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-99.11362,20.61409.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: http://www.nascentis.com/. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

71.47000,51.16000.name: National Center for Biotechnology of Kazakhstan
71.47000,51.16000.desc: Central Asia’s largest biotechnology research institute, working on crops for steppe conditions and on veterinary vaccines. The region grows wheat at enormous scale and appears almost nowhere in accounts of agricultural biotechnology, which is a gap in the telling rather than in the activity.

-78.80000,35.80000.name: Believer Meats
-78.80000,35.80000.desc: Building what it describes as the largest cultivated meat plant in the world, in North Carolina, having originated in Israel. Capacity rather than approval is now the constraint in this sector, and plants of this size are being built ahead of any market able to absorb them — which is either conviction or the same mistake the biofuel sector made.
